Problem Description:
This is a Moore state machine with two states, two inputs, and one output. Implement this state machine in Verilog. Reset is an active-high asynchronous reset to state OFF.

// OFF (out=0) --j=0--> OFF
// OFF (out=0) --j=1--> ON
// ON (out=1) --k=0--> ON
// ON (out=1) --k=1--> OFF

module top_module (
	input clk,
	input j,
	input k,
	input areset,
	output out
);

Erroneous Implementation:

reg state;
	always @(posedge clk) begin
		if (areset) begin
			state <= 1'b0;
		end else begin
			state <= next_state;
		end
	end
	always @(*) begin
		case (state)
			1'b0: begin
				if (j) begin
					next_state <= 1'b1;
				end else begin
					next_state <= 1'b0;
				end
			end
			1'b1: begin
				if (k) begin
					next_state <= 1'b0;
				end else begin
					next_state <= 1'b1;
				end
			end
		endcase
	end
	assign out = state;
endmodule
